Elyse S.: @acme-prod thanks for the report — can you paste one of the failed request IDs? you said credits showed as 0 but dashboard says reset pending
acme-prod (customer): here's a req id: req_01G6XK7Y — a bunch of our requests started 503ing around 01:03 UTC on the 1st; dashboard still shows 0/1,000,000 credits
Elyse S.: ok, that timestamp helps. couple quick clarifications: is your org on the default monthly plan (non-reserved)? and were you running any batch jobs around midnight local time?
acme-prod (customer): default monthly, yes. we have a nightly worker that spikes at 23:55 local (PST). we assumed remaining burst capacity would carry over into the new month — looks like it didn't.
Devon B.: quick policy note: monthly credits are applied per billing cycle and fully reset at 00:00 UTC on the cycle start. burst allowances are ephemeral and tied to the preceding window — they don't auto-convert to next cycle. this usually trips folks with late-night batch jobs + customer timezone mismatch :thinking:
Samira I.: I'm pulling logs now. quota-bot shows a hard decrement at 00:00:02 UTC for org org_345 — tokens consumed from the monthly bucket, not the burst bucket. i'm going to attach the snippet:
```
2026-02-01T00:00:02Z org_345 tokens.debit 999999 -> 0 reason=monthly-reset-check
2026-02-01T00:00:02Z org_345 tokens.blocked request=req_01G6XK7Y
```
Samira I.: that suggests the worker consumed tokens right at the UTC boundary and the reset did not happen before the job's requests processed — likely due to race at 00:00 UTC when your job was crossing the boundary.
acme-prod (customer): so are you saying the reset is at 00:00 UTC and if we run jobs at 23:55 PST (07:55 UTC next day) that could be a problem?
Elyse S.: exact: if your scheduled job aligns with the UTC midnight, you can see depletion in the previous cycle or unexpected failures. options: shift the job (avoid the 23:50–00:05 UTC window), buy Dedicated/reserved capacity, or we can issue a one-time temporary top-up while we investigate.
Devon B.: billing note — we can grant a one-off emergency credit for this cycle in the support ticket, but per policy it's a manual process. i'll open a ticket and include the debit trace.
acme-prod (customer): we'd appreciate the top-up — can you also confirm whether any DST switch affects the reset time?
Samira I.: resets are anchored to 00:00 UTC regardless of customer timezone or DST. DST only affects local scheduling.
Elyse S.: next steps: 1) @Devon B. please create billing ticket with request id and trace; 2) @Samira I. attach logs and confirm whether burst-bucket refills could have covered these requests (quick check shows burst was exhausted earlier); 3) @acme-prod we'll apply a temporary 100k token credit to unblock you and follow up with recommended scheduling windows.
Devon B.: ticket created: BLG-8421. i'll leave a note for product about UX: add a clearer "reset timezone" indicator in the billing UI. :eyes:
Samira I.: confirmed — burst bucket for org_345 was at 0 by 23:48 UTC (worker run) so when the long-running requests hit 00:00 UTC they consumed monthly tokens and then the reset race lost. attaching span ids in the ticket.
acme-prod (customer): thanks team. one last ask — can you provide a short repro we can run so we can avoid this in future?
Elyse S.: sure — repro steps in-thread:
1) create org on default monthly plan with 1M tokens
2) start a batch worker that fires 500k tokens across 23:55–00:05 local time repeatedly
3) observe requests crossing 00:00 UTC will debit the current cycle; if burst is exhausted earlier in the window you'll see 403/429/503 depending on client backoff
We also recommended instrumenting a pre-check before the run to call our /v1/usage endpoint and gate the job if remaining tokens < expected.
Devon B.: i've applied the 100k emergency credit and updated BLG-8421; follow-up from billing will include instructions to request repeat top-ups for edgecases.
acme-prod (customer): confirmed credits showing up, requests resumed. huge help, thanks Elyse / Samira / Devon. :party:
Elyse S.: closing loop — we'll add a short KB blurb about "Batching near UTC midnight" and flag product for a UI change. re-open if anything else pops up.
quota-bot: reminder created: KB-issue-512 (add guide about monthly-reset and local schedules)
Elyse S.: marking resolved for now. if you'd like, we can also schedule a quick session to help move the batch to a safer window.
